data.one_liner: Prompt users for in-app updates using StoreKit on iOS and Play Core API on Android.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that provides native in-app update experiences. It uses StoreKit on iOS to display the App Store product page inside the app and Google Play's In-App Updates API on Android for immediate or flexible update flows.
use_when: You want to prompt users to update your app directly inside the app on Android and iOS.
You need to support immediate or flexible update flows on Android using Google Play.
You want to check for available updates and download progress programmatically.
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than Android and iOS (such as Web or Desktop).
You prefer completely custom UI update prompts rather than native store sheets.
strengths: Supports native in-app updates on both Android and iOS from a single package.
Provides stream-based tracking of download progress on Android.
Allows checking version availability before displaying prompts on both platforms.
weaknesses: iOS version checking relies on an unofficial iTunes Lookup endpoint that can experience CDN caching delays.
iOS does not support true forced blocking updates natively.
Does not work on iOS simulators.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 13.0 or later and testing on a real device. No native setup or AppDelegate changes needed.
